evals.prompt: Create a branch for issue #42 in billing-api. It adds retry logic to the invoice webhook sender.
evals.expected_output: A branch named like feature/42-invoice-webhook-retry is created from the detected trunk branch and checked out.
expectations: The branch name starts with feature/42- followed by a three to five word lowercase slug
The transcript runs git symbolic-ref or git show-ref to detect the trunk branch before git checkout -b
The final message names the created branch and reminds the user to run git push -u origin <branch-name>

evals.prompt: Make me a bugfix branch for the null cursor crash in web-app.
evals.expected_output: The agent asks for the issue number (or offers to create the issue) before creating any branch, because bugfix/ branches require one.
expectations: The agent asks for an issue number or offers gh issue create before running git checkout -b
No branch is created while the issue number is unknown
Once a number is given, the branch name has the form bugfix/<number>-<slug>

evals.prompt: Is `Feature/Add_Login-Page` a valid branch name for acme's repo? If not, fix it; it is for issue 7.
evals.expected_output: The agent reports the violations (uppercase, underscore, missing issue number) and proposes feature/7-add-login-page.
expectations: The reply lists uppercase letters and the underscore as rule violations
The reply flags the missing issue number for a feature/ branch
The corrected name is lowercase, uses hyphens only, and starts with feature/7-
The agent does not create the branch unless the user asks for it
